original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳国企薪酬改革：IPEC将确保公平与可持续性
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳公平工资与薪金委员会（FWSC）首席执行官George Smith-Graham呼吁国有企业负责人支持政府建立独立、公平且可持续的公共部门薪酬体系。他在与国企负责人就FWSC向独立公共薪酬委员会（IPEC）过渡举行的利益相关方磋商会上发出上述呼吁。该事件为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 加纳FWSC首席执行官呼吁国企负责人支持建立独立、公平、可持续的公共部门薪酬体系
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Chief Executive of the Fair Wages and Salaries Commission (FWSC), Dr. George Smith-Graham, has called on Chief Executives of State-Owned Enterprises (SOEs) to support government's move to establish an independent, equitable and sustainable compensation system for the public sector.

key_facts.fact: 该呼吁是在FWSC向独立公共薪酬委员会（IPEC）过渡的国企负责人利益相关方磋商会上提出的
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He made the call in his welcome address at the opening of a day's stakeholder engagement with Chief Executives of SOEs on the transition of the FWSC to the Independent Public Emoluments Commission (IPEC).

uncertainties: 该事件目前仅有一个来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
